name: text-reverse-erase
title: Reverse-Order Erase
description: Chữ biến mất bằng đúng chuyển động lúc vào nhưng chạy ngược, ký tự cuối đi trước.

moworks.author: moworks

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Entrance: chars y +24 px (0.5 em) → 0 and fade in, 0.5 s easeOutCubic, stagger 60 ms (demo capped 0.5 s) from 0.3 s. Hold ~1 s. Exit (demo 2.2 s) = the same timeline played backward: the last char leaves first, each char retraces its path (opacity → 0, y → +0.5 em) on the time-reversed curve (ease-in shape), same 0.5 s and 60 ms stagger. AE: Range Selector Mode Subtract, stagger from end. Loop 3.6 s. Params: duration (0.5 s) · stagger (0.06 s) · y (24 px) · hold: giữ trước khi xoá (1 s). The exit is the entrance played backward: the last letter leaves first, each on the time-reversed curve.
moworks.titleVi: Xoá chữ bằng đường vào chạy ngược
